protocol_notes: iDEM NLL is held-out target likelihood under a separate OT-CFM fit, not negative mean target log p of generated points.
iDEM ESS is generated-model importance ESS, not OptiQ candidate ESS.
Paper covariance text differs from public code; released DEM uses FAB log_var_scaling=1, giving sigma=softplus(1), identical to canonical target here.
Published GMM TV is 2D 200x200 histogram. Current public DEM code exposes generic 1D interatomic histogram, which cannot silently substitute for this metric.
Use new validation samples during tuning, fresh independent confirmation evaluation; count all search compute separately from final training.
